interpretation_limits: A high match score means economic similarity under this specification; it does not verify absence of an unrecorded data center.
Two national inventories reduce false negatives but do not prove absence, so every candidate still requires local facility-absence research before analytical use.
The available national panel does not yet include industry mix, urban-rural classification, electricity-market structure, tax policy, water conditions, or major concurrent investments.
These are descriptive comparison candidates, not causal estimates or finalized donor pools.

method.baseline_rule: Use five years before the earliest documented study-project anchor when available; otherwise use the labeled 2001–2005 structural window.
method.candidate_pool: Counties outside the 35-host cohort with zero linked records in both the repository active-facility inventory and the pinned external national registry, plus complete baseline features.
method.distance: Square root of the weighted sum of squared feature differences standardized by candidate-pool interquartile ranges, plus disclosed Census-geography penalties.
method.score: 100 / (1 + standardized distance). Scores rank candidates within a host specification and are not probabilities.

scope: Identify economically comparable counties for each of the 35 active-project host counties using counties with zero known data-center facility or project records across the repository inventory and the pinned external national registry.
